meta.note: Live-wins dedup against existing corpus; geography- and institution-as-a-node scaffolding stripped; see notes/mint-2026-08-20.md

reports.title: Lei nº 5.534, de 14 de novembro de 1968
reports.publisher: Presidência da República / Congresso Nacional
reports.description: Principal legislation establishing the obligation of natural and legal persons under Brazilian jurisdiction to provide statistical information requested by the Fundação IBGE for the execution of the National Statistics Plan (Plano Nacional de Estatística). Guarantees absolute confidentiality of responses, which may be used exclusively for statistical purposes and cannot serve as evidence in administrative, fiscal or judicial proceedings except for infractions of the law itself. Still the foundational legal basis for mandatory response and statistical secrecy cited in all major IBGE operations including the Censo Demográfico.

reports.title: Lei nº 5.878, de 11 de maio de 1973
reports.publisher: Presidência da República / Congresso Nacional
reports.description: Organic law of the Fundação Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE). Defines IBGE’s basic objective as ensuring statistical, geographic, cartographic and demographic information necessary for knowledge of the physical, economic and social reality of the country. Institutes the Plano Geral de Informações Estatísticas e Geográficas (PGIEG) as the instrument for orientation and coordination of information production. Reaffirms the obligation to provide information and the exclusivity of statistical use. Still the core institutional statute referenced alongside the 1968 secrecy law.

reports.title: Decreto nº 11.177, de 18 de agosto de 2022 (Estatuto do IBGE)
reports.publisher: Presidência da República
reports.description: Current statute of the Fundação Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística. Approves the organisational structure, commission posts and trust functions of IBGE (in force from 3 October 2022). Succeeds earlier statutes and provides the operational framework under which IBGE exercises its statistical and geographic mandates derived from Lei 5.878/1973 and related instruments.

reports.title: Sistema de Contas Nacionais (SCN)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Brazil’s national accounts system compiled in accordance with the United Nations System of National Accounts (SNA 2008). Produces the principal macroeconomic aggregates including Gross Domestic Product (PIB), Gross Value Added, institutional sector accounts, integrated economic accounts, supply and use tables, and related indicators (investment rate, savings rate, etc.). Annual results published with technical notes; quarterly national accounts also produced. Reference year currently 2010 series with a base-year revision to 2021 under development. Serves as the central macroeconomic framework for Brazil.

reports.title: Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor Amplo (IPCA)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Official consumer price index used by the Brazilian government for inflation targeting and as the primary measure of retail inflation. Covers households with monthly income from 1 to 40 minimum wages. Monthly release covering a fixed basket of goods and services collected in major metropolitan areas and selected capitals. Current series incorporates expenditure structures from the Pesquisa de Orçamentos Familiares (POF). Closely related INPC covers the narrower 1–5 minimum-wage income range. IPCA is the reference series for monetary policy and many contractual adjustments.

reports.title: Pesquisa Nacional por Amostra de Domicílios Contínua (PNAD Contínua)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Continuous household sample survey providing quarterly and annual labour-force and socio-economic statistics. Principal source for unemployment rate (taxa de desocupação), labour-force participation, employment, earnings, informality and related indicators. Sample of approximately 211 000 households per quarter across ~16 000 census tracts. Results released for Brazil, Major Regions, Federation Units, capital municipalities and selected metropolitan regions. Follows ILO recommendations (19th ICLS). Complements the decennial census with high-frequency labour-market monitoring.

reports.title: Pesquisa Industrial Mensal – Produção Física (PIM-PF)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Monthly industrial production index measuring short-term changes in the physical volume of production in extractive and manufacturing industries (CNAE sections B and C). National and regional series (selected Federation Units meeting minimum value-added thresholds). Base year currently 2022=100. Key high-frequency indicator used in the compilation of quarterly national accounts and industrial analysis. Covers ~8 600 enterprises / 12 500 local units and more than 1 000 products.

reports.title: Censo Demográfico
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Decennial population and housing census providing the most comprehensive demographic, social and economic profile of the Brazilian population. The 2022 Census (13th operation) collected data from 1 August 2022 to 28 May 2023 (with subsequent revisions). Results released progressively by theme (population and households, literacy, indigenous and quilombola populations, urban characteristics, sample results on labour, education, fertility, etc.). Primary source for population totals, municipal population, demographic structure and many derived indicators used across the statistical system and for inter-governmental transfers.

reports.title: Censo Agropecuário
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Principal structural survey of agricultural, forestry and aquaculture establishments in Brazil. Provides data on number and size of establishments, land use, livestock, machinery, production, employment, producer characteristics and related topics at municipal and higher geographic levels. Currently conducted on a roughly decennial cycle (mid-decade between demographic censuses). The 12th Censo Agropecuário (Florestal e Aquícola) is in preparation with field collection planned for 2027 and definitive results targeted for 2028. Essential input into national accounts agricultural estimates and rural policy analysis.

reports.title: Balanço de Pagamentos / Estatísticas do Setor Externo
reports.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil (BCB)
reports.description: Official balance-of-payments and external-sector statistics compiled by the Central Bank of Brazil in accordance with the IMF Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6). Covers current account (goods, services, primary and secondary income), capital and financial account (direct investment, portfolio investment, other investment, reserves), and related aggregates. Monthly, quarterly and annual series published. Key source for external-sector analysis and an input into the national accounts external transactions.

reports.title: Contas Regionais do Brasil
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Regional accounts system providing Gross Domestic Product and related aggregates for the Federation Units (states and Federal District) and, at a more detailed level, for municipalities (Produto Interno Bruto dos Municípios). Compiled consistently with the national Sistema de Contas Nacionais and SNA 2008. Annual publication. Forms the principal vertical bridge from national to state and municipal economic activity measures.

reports.title: Balanço Energético Nacional (BEN)
reports.publisher: Empresa de Pesquisa Energética (EPE)
reports.description: Annual comprehensive energy balance documenting primary energy production, transformation, imports/exports, distribution and final consumption by source and sector. Includes Relatório Síntese (early release) and full consolidated report. Legal basis in Lei nº 10.847 (competence of EPE). Primary reference for Brazil’s energy matrix, renewables share, and emissions associated with the energy sector. Used across energy planning, national accounts energy inputs, and international comparisons.

reports.title: Anuário Estatístico de Energia Elétrica
reports.publisher: Empresa de Pesquisa Energética (EPE)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of the electricity chain covering generation capacity, production, consumption by class (residential, industrial, commercial, etc.), regional and Federation Unit detail, and related indicators. Complements the broader Balanço Energético Nacional with electricity-specific series and interactive tools. Key high-level source for power-sector analysis and planning.

reports.title: Produção Agrícola Municipal (PAM)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual municipal-level survey of temporary and permanent crop production covering area planted/harvested, quantity produced, average yield and production value for 64 products (31 temporary, 33 permanent). Integrated with the monthly LSPA for multi-harvest crops. Results published for municipalities, micro/mesoregions, Federation Units, Major Regions and Brazil. Core structural input for agricultural value-added in national and regional accounts.

reports.title: Levantamento Sistemático da Produção Agrícola (LSPA)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Monthly systematic survey tracking forecasts and outcomes of major agricultural harvests (cereals, oilseeds, pulses, selected permanent crops) at municipal and higher levels. Provides early indicators of production, area and yield that are later consolidated into the annual PAM for the multi-harvest crops. Primary high-frequency agricultural production monitor used by government and markets.

reports.title: Pesquisa Industrial Anual – Empresa (PIA-Empresa)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual structural survey of industrial enterprises (extractive and manufacturing) covering economic-financial variables: number of enterprises, employment, salaries, revenue, costs, value added, fixed capital formation and related indicators. Part of the modernised enterprise statistics programme based on CEMPRE. Results feed industrial value-added benchmarks in the Sistema de Contas Nacionais and support structural analysis of industry.

reports.title: Pesquisa Industrial Anual – Produto (PIA-Produto)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual survey of the quantity and value of industrial products and industrial services produced by the principal industrial enterprises, classified according to PRODLIST (aligned with CNAE and NCM). Complements PIA-Empresa by providing product-level detail. Used for industrial composition analysis and as input to supply-and-use tables in national accounts.

reports.title: Pesquisa Anual de Serviços (PAS)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual structural survey of non-financial service enterprises covering revenue, employment, personnel costs, fixed assets and related variables for major service groupings (family services, information & communication, professional/administrative, transport, real estate, repair, other). Results published for Brazil, Major Regions and Federation Units. Principal source for services value-added benchmarks in national accounts (excluding health and education in the core series).

reports.title: Pesquisa Anual de Comércio (PAC)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual structural survey of commercial enterprises (wholesale, retail, motor-vehicle trade) covering number of enterprises, employment, net operating revenue, commercial margins, salaries and related indicators. Results by Brazil, Major Regions and Federation Units. Key input for trade-sector value added and distribution margins in the national accounts supply-and-use framework.

reports.title: Pesquisa Anual da Indústria da Construção (PAIC)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual structural survey of construction enterprises covering number of firms, employment, salaries, value of incorporations/works/services, and product groupings (infrastructure, buildings, specialised services). Results for Brazil, Major Regions and Federation Units. Primary structural source for construction value added and investment-related estimates in national accounts.

reports.title: Pesquisa de Orçamentos Familiares (POF)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Quinquennial household budget survey investigating expenditure structures, income, living conditions and nutritional aspects of Brazilian families. Sample of more than 100 000 households. Results used to update weighting structures of the IPCA/INPC consumer price indices and to analyse consumption patterns, inequality and living standards. Latest full cycle 2017–2018; 2024–2025 cycle in field.

reports.title: Estatísticas do Registro Civil
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual vital statistics compiled from civil-registry offices (Cartórios de Registro Civil) and family courts covering live births, marriages, deaths, foetal deaths and divorces (judicial and extrajudicial). Provides continuous demographic indicators complementary to the decennial census and supports fertility, nuptiality and mortality analysis at national, regional and local levels.

reports.title: Contas Econômicas Ambientais (CEA)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Environmental-economic accounts compiled under the UN System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA) framework. Includes physical and monetary accounts for water, land, energy, forests and experimental ecosystem accounts. Produced in partnership with specialised agencies (e.g., ANA for water). Provides integrated measures of natural-resource stocks, flows and interactions with the economy that complement the conventional Sistema de Contas Nacionais.

reports.title: Contas Regionais do Brasil – Unidades da Federação (PIB Estadual)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual regional accounts providing Gross Domestic Product, value added by major sectors, and related aggregates for each of the 27 Federation Units (states + DF). Compiled in methodological partnership with state statistical offices under a uniform SNA-consistent framework linked to the national Sistema de Contas Nacionais. Forms the principal official series for inter-state comparison and the bridge from national to state economic activity. Municipal GDP series are produced in the same programme.

reports.title: PIB do Estado de São Paulo (SEADE)
reports.publisher: Fundação Sistema Estadual de Análise de Dados (SEADE)
reports.description: State-level Gross Domestic Product series for São Paulo produced by Fundação SEADE, including annual and quarterly estimates, regional disaggregation within the state, sectoral composition and volume indices. Published with methodological notes and open data. São Paulo accounts for roughly 30% of Brazilian GDP; the SEADE series is the primary official state product and is methodologically aligned with IBGE Contas Regionais.

reports.title: PIB de Minas Gerais (Fundação João Pinheiro)
reports.publisher: Fundação João Pinheiro (FJP)
reports.description: Annual and quarterly Gross Domestic Product estimates for Minas Gerais produced by Fundação João Pinheiro. Includes sectoral value-added detail (agropecuária, indústria, serviços), participation in national GDP, and technical informatives. Minas Gerais is one of the largest state economies; the FJP series is the official state product and participates in the IBGE Contas Regionais partnership.

reports.title: PIB do Rio Grande do Sul (DEE/SPGG)
reports.publisher: Departamento de Economia e Estatística (DEE), Secretaria de Planejamento, Governança e Gestão – RS
reports.description: State Gross Domestic Product series (annual and quarterly) calculated by the Departamento de Economia e Estatística of Rio Grande do Sul in methodological partnership with IBGE. Includes sectoral breakdown, volume indices, municipal GDP and interactive visualisation tools (PIBVis). RS is a major southern agricultural and industrial economy; the DEE series is the official state product.

reports.title: PIB da Bahia (SEI)
reports.publisher: Superintendência de Estudos Econômicos e Sociais da Bahia (SEI)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual Gross Domestic Product estimates for Bahia produced by the Superintendência de Estudos Econômicos e Sociais da Bahia. Includes sectoral value added, growth rates and municipal PIB series. Bahia is the largest North-East economy and provides a regional contrast to the South-East industrial core; the SEI series is the official state product and feeds the national Contas Regionais programme.

reports.title: PIB do Amazonas (SEDECTI)
reports.publisher: Secretaria de Estado de Desenvolvimento Econômico, Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação do Amazonas (SEDECTI)
reports.description: State Gross Domestic Product estimates for Amazonas published by SEDECTI, covering quarterly and annual results with sectoral detail (industry dominated by the Manaus Free Trade Zone, services, agropecuária). Amazonas supplies the Amazon / Northern contrast within the BRICS domestic layer; the series is aligned with IBGE Contas Regionais and highlights the concentration of activity in the capital Manaus.

reports.title: Anuário Estatístico do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (CEPERJ)
reports.publisher: Fundação Centro Estadual de Estatísticas, Pesquisas e Formação de Servidores Públicos do Rio de Janeiro (CEPERJ)
reports.description: Periodic statistical yearbook of the State of Rio de Janeiro compiled by CEPERJ, presenting a synthesis of demographic, economic, social and fiscal indicators for the state and its municipalities. Serves as the principal multi-thematic reference publication for the state statistical system. Complements the national Contas Regionais series for Rio de Janeiro.

reports.title: Indicadores e Séries SEADE (São Paulo)
reports.publisher: Fundação Sistema Estadual de Análise de Dados (SEADE)
reports.description: Broad suite of recurring indicators produced by SEADE covering labour market, population estimates and projections, social vulnerability (IPVS), municipal development (IPDM), economic performance of industry/commerce/services, and related thematic series. Complements the core PIB product and constitutes the main multi-domain statistical output of the São Paulo state statistical system.

reports.title: Contas Regionais de Minas Gerais (FJP)
reports.publisher: Fundação João Pinheiro (FJP)
reports.description: Detailed regional accounts publication for Minas Gerais produced by Fundação João Pinheiro (Estatística & Informações series). Provides value-added by activity, income and related aggregates consistent with the national Contas Regionais framework. Serves as the fuller methodological and analytical companion to the high-frequency PIB releases.

reports.title: Produto Interno Bruto dos Municípios
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual estimates of municipal Gross Domestic Product and value added by major sectors for all Brazilian municipalities, produced by IBGE in partnership with state statistical offices and SUFRAMA. Fully consistent with the Contas Regionais and national accounts methodologies. Provides the finest geographic resolution of economic activity and the vertical link from state to municipal level.

reports.title: ObservaSampa – Observatório de Indicadores da Cidade de São Paulo
reports.publisher: Prefeitura Municipal de São Paulo (SEPLAN / Coordenadoria de Planejamento, Monitoramento e Avaliação)
reports.description: Municipal indicator observatory for the City of São Paulo presenting multi-thematic panels and open data on population, economy, labour and income, education, health, housing, environment, mobility, public finance, security and other domains. Managed under municipal decree as a standing policy instrument for planning, monitoring and public transparency. Primary municipal-level statistical product for Brazil’s largest city (≈9.7% of national GDP).
reports._domains_note: Tagged general-statistics (promoted into the Domain union 2026-08-18). This is a general multi-domain statistical compendium — a state/district yearbook or abstract — and its only original tag was a geographic or 'comprehensive' pseudo-tag that the 2026-08-18 domain pass dropped. Dropping 'comprehensive' was right for batch-meta nodes and wrong here: for a yearbook, 'covers everything' is a fact about the content. Asserting the individual domains it covers would be inventing them.

reports.title: DATA.Rio (Instituto Pereira Passos)
reports.publisher: Instituto Pereira Passos (IPP) / Prefeitura da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
reports.description: Municipal data platform and statistical production centre of the City of Rio de Janeiro. Publishes demographic aggregates (including Censo 2022 by bairro / RA / AP), social progress indices (IPS Bairros), urban indicators, tourism statistics and geospatial data. Operates as the principal municipal statistical and cartographic reference for Rio de Janeiro municipality.

reports.title: Anuário Estatístico de Porto Alegre
reports.publisher: Prefeitura Municipal de Porto Alegre
reports.description: Long-running municipal statistical yearbook (53rd edition by 2023) of Porto Alegre. Originally a static PDF publication; recent editions restructured as interactive thematic panels covering demographic, socio-economic and administrative indicators linked to municipal policy domains. Serves as the primary multi-domain statistical synthesis for the capital of Rio Grande do Sul.

reports.title: Anuário Estatístico do Amazonas
reports.publisher: Secretaria de Estado de Desenvolvimento Econômico, Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação do Amazonas (SEDECTI)
reports.description: Official multi-thematic statistical yearbook of Amazonas (35th edition, 2025). Covers characterisation of the state, population, health, education, economic resources, finance/market and public services. Recent editions published as an interactive digital platform. Provides the principal consolidated statistical reference for the state and its capital Manaus (dominant share of state GDP).

reports.title: Anuário Estatístico da Bahia (SEI)
reports.publisher: Superintendência de Estudos Econômicos e Sociais da Bahia (SEI)
reports.description: Historic multi-thematic statistical yearbook of Bahia published by SEI, covering geographic, demographic, social and economic data for the state’s municipalities. Complements the SEI PIB series and provides the broader statistical context for Salvador and other Bahian municipalities. (Publication frequency reduced after 2019; retained as the canonical titled series.)

reports.title: PIB do Município de São Paulo (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for the City of São Paulo produced within the IBGE Contas Regionais / PIB dos Municípios programme. São Paulo municipality accounts for approximately 9.7% of Brazilian GDP and roughly one-third of the state of São Paulo’s GDP. Forms the direct vertical link from the municipal to the state and national accounts.

reports.title: PIB do Município do Rio de Janeiro (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for the City of Rio de Janeiro within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Second-largest municipal economy in Brazil (≈3.8% of national GDP). Provides the official municipal-to-state vertical bridge for Rio de Janeiro.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Belo Horizonte (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Belo Horizonte within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. One of the ten largest municipal economies in Brazil. Links the capital of Minas Gerais into the state and national accounts hierarchy.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Manaus (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Manaus within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme (in partnership with SUFRAMA for Free Trade Zone activity). Manaus accounts for roughly 80% of Amazonas state GDP and is among the ten largest municipal economies nationally. Provides the Amazon metropolitan contrast node.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Porto Alegre (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Porto Alegre within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Rio Grande do Sul and one of the larger southern municipal economies. Completes the vertical chain from municipal to state (DEE) to national accounts for the southern high-output node.

reports.title: Resultado do Tesouro Nacional (RTN)
reports.publisher: Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional (STN)
reports.description: Monthly official fiscal statistics of the Central Government (Tesouro Nacional + Previdência Social + Banco Central) compiled on an above-the-line basis. Presents primary result, detailed primary revenues and expenditures, and evolution of net debt of the National Treasury. Published since 1995; principal vehicle for monitoring fiscal policy and the primary-result target set in the LDO. Complements the below-the-line fiscal statistics published by the Banco Central.

reports.title: Estatísticas Monetárias (Base Monetária e Agregados)
reports.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil (BCB)
reports.description: Monthly monetary statistics covering the monetary base (restricted and broad), monetary aggregates, and the monetary authority survey (assets and liabilities of the Central Bank). Includes currency in circulation, bank reserves and counterpart items. Core high-frequency input for monetary-policy analysis and for the financial-sector accounts of the national accounts framework.

reports.title: Reservas Internacionais
reports.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil (BCB)
reports.description: Official statistics on Brazil’s international reserves managed by the Central Bank. Includes stock, composition (securities, deposits, gold, SDRs, etc.), variation demonstrative and management reports. Published with daily, monthly and historical series. Key external-sector stock indicator complementary to the flow data of the Balanço de Pagamentos.

reports.title: Censo Escolar da Educação Básica
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira (INEP / MEC)
reports.description: Annual census of basic education (educação infantil, ensino fundamental, ensino médio, educação profissional, EJA) covering enrolments, teachers, school managers and schools. Produces the Sinopse Estatística da Educação Básica, technical notes, microdata and derived indicators. Principal structural source for the Brazilian education system and input into education-related components of national and social statistics.

reports.title: Pesquisa Nacional de Saúde (PNS)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) in partnership with Ministério da Saúde
reports.description: National household health survey providing comprehensive data on health status, access to and use of health services, lifestyle factors, chronic diseases and related socio-demographic characteristics. Evolved from earlier PNAD health supplements; conducted periodically (major cycles 2013, 2019 and subsequent). Primary population-based health survey for Brazil.

reports.title: Pesquisa Nacional de Saúde do Escolar (PeNSE)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) in partnership with Ministério da Saúde and Ministério da Educação
reports.description: National school-based survey of risk and protective factors for adolescent health. Fifth edition (2024) provides updated prevalence and distribution of behaviours and conditions among Brazilian schoolchildren. Supports the Ministry of Health’s surveillance system for adolescent health and informs education and health policy.

reports.title: PNAD Contínua – Módulo Anual de Educação
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Annual education module of the continuous PNAD Contínua, collected in the second quarter, expanding the basic education questions of the core questionnaire. Provides detailed indicators on school attendance, educational attainment, literacy and related characteristics for the population aged 5 and over. Complements the structural Censo Escolar with household-based education statistics.

reports.title: Nota de Política Fiscal / Resultado Fiscal Abaixo da Linha (BCB)
reports.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil (BCB)
reports.description: Monthly below-the-line fiscal result of the public sector published by the Banco Central, focusing on the financing of the fiscal balance through changes in net debt (domestic and external sources). Complements the above-the-line Resultado do Tesouro Nacional (STN) and is the series used for formal verification of the primary-result target in some analytical contexts.

reports.title: Contas Financeiras / Contas Econômicas Integradas (componentes financeiros)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Financial accounts and related integrated economic accounts components within the Sistema de Contas Nacionais. Record transactions and stocks of financial assets and liabilities by institutional sector. Draw on BCB monetary and financial statistics as primary inputs and provide the macroeconomic framework linking real and financial sides of the economy.

reports.title: Sinopse Estatística da Educação Básica
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira (INEP / MEC)
reports.description: Annual statistical synopsis derived from the Censo Escolar da Educação Básica, presenting summarised tables and indicators on enrolments, teachers, schools and education stages. Principal published tabular product of the school census and widely used reference for education planning and research.

reports.title: PIB do Paraná (IPARDES)
reports.publisher: Instituto Paranaense de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (IPARDES)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual Gross Domestic Product series for Paraná produced by IPARDES in methodological cooperation with IBGE Contas Regionais. Includes volume indices, sectoral detail and municipal participation. Paraná ranks among the top four state economies; the IPARDES series is the official state product and supplies the southern high-output complement to SP/MG/RS.

reports.title: PIB de Santa Catarina (SEPLAN-SC)
reports.publisher: Secretaria de Estado do Planejamento de Santa Catarina (SEPLAN)
reports.description: State Gross Domestic Product estimates and analyses produced by SEPLAN-SC, including annual results, municipal GDP commentary and sectoral performance (industry, services, agropecuária). Santa Catarina is a high-productivity southern economy (top-tier PIB per capita); the SEPLAN series participates in the IBGE Contas Regionais partnership and provides the SC high-output node.

reports.title: Estatísticas e PIB de Pernambuco (CONDEPE/FIDEM)
reports.publisher: Agência Estadual de Planejamento e Pesquisa de Pernambuco (CONDEPE/FIDEM)
reports.description: State statistical and planning products of Pernambuco, including population platforms (Pernambuco em Mapas), municipal data and economic indicators aligned with IBGE Contas Regionais. Pernambuco is a major North-East economy and provides additional regional contrast beyond Bahia; CONDEPE/FIDEM is the principal state statistical reference.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Curitiba (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Curitiba within the IBGE Contas Regionais / PIB dos Municípios programme. Capital of Paraná and one of the larger southern municipal economies; anchors the vertical chain for the PR state node.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Recife (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Recife within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Pernambuco and principal metropolitan economy of the state; provides the municipal anchor for the PE North-East contrast node.

reports.title: Censo da Educação Superior
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira (INEP / MEC)
reports.description: Annual census of higher education covering institutions (IES), undergraduate and sequential courses, vacancies, candidates, enrolments, entrants, graduates and teaching staff. Collects data via the e-MEC register. Principal structural source for the Brazilian higher-education system and the natural counterpart to the Censo Escolar da Educação Básica.

reports.title: Sinopse Estatística da Educação Superior
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira (INEP / MEC)
reports.description: Annual statistical synopsis derived from the Censo da Educação Superior, presenting summarised tables and indicators on institutions, courses, students and staff, including municipal-level detail in recent editions. Principal published tabular product of the higher-education census.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Florianópolis (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Florianópolis within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Santa Catarina; anchors the vertical chain for the SC state node alongside larger industrial municipalities (Joinville, Itajaí).

reports.title: Paraná em Números (IPARDES)
reports.publisher: Instituto Paranaense de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (IPARDES)
reports.description: Interactive multi-thematic statistical panel produced by IPARDES covering population, urbanisation and infrastructure, state and municipal PIB, industry, agropecuária, foreign trade, labour market, environment and tourism. Complements the core PIB series and constitutes the principal multi-domain statistical output of the Paraná state statistical system.
reports._domains_note: Tagged general-statistics (promoted into the Domain union 2026-08-18). This is a general multi-domain statistical compendium — a state/district yearbook or abstract — and its only original tag was a geographic or 'comprehensive' pseudo-tag that the 2026-08-18 domain pass dropped. Dropping 'comprehensive' was right for batch-meta nodes and wrong here: for a yearbook, 'covers everything' is a fact about the content. Asserting the individual domains it covers would be inventing them.

reports.title: Notas Estatísticas do Censo da Educação Superior
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira (INEP / MEC)
reports.description: Annual statistical notes presenting the main results and trends of the Censo da Educação Superior. Complements the Sinopse with analytical highlights on enrolments, institutions, modalities (including distance education) and related indicators over multi-year horizons.

reports.title: PIB do Ceará (IPECE)
reports.publisher: Instituto de Pesquisa e Estratégia Econômica do Ceará (IPECE)
reports.description: State Gross Domestic Product series for Ceará produced by IPECE, including annual and quarterly results with sectoral detail. Ceará provides additional North-East contrast (alongside BA and PE); the IPECE series participates in the IBGE Contas Regionais framework and is the official state product.

reports.title: Ceará em Números (IPECE)
reports.publisher: Instituto de Pesquisa e Estratégia Econômica do Ceará (IPECE)
reports.description: Multi-thematic statistical compendium produced by IPECE covering economic development, PIB, social and demographic indicators for Ceará. Complements the core PIB series and constitutes the principal multi-domain statistical reference for the state.
reports._domains_note: Tagged general-statistics (promoted into the Domain union 2026-08-18). This is a general multi-domain statistical compendium — a state/district yearbook or abstract — and its only original tag was a geographic or 'comprehensive' pseudo-tag that the 2026-08-18 domain pass dropped. Dropping 'comprehensive' was right for batch-meta nodes and wrong here: for a yearbook, 'covers everything' is a fact about the content. Asserting the individual domains it covers would be inventing them.

reports.title: PIB do Distrito Federal (IPEDF / CODEPLAN)
reports.publisher: Instituto de Pesquisa e Estatística do Distrito Federal (IPEDF / CODEPLAN)
reports.description: Gross Domestic Product of the Distrito Federal calculated by IPEDF as the official partner of IBGE in the Contas Regionais system. Includes annual results and a quarterly series (methodology own to IPEDF since 2022). DF has the highest PIB per capita among Federation Units and is a distinct institutional-capital node.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Fortaleza (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Fortaleza within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Ceará and principal metropolitan economy of the state; anchors the vertical chain for the CE North-East contrast node.

reports.title: PIB do Município de Brasília (IBGE Contas Regionais)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Brasília (essentially coincident with the Distrito Federal in statistical practice) within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. One of the largest municipal economies and the institutional capital node.

reports.title: Pesquisa de Inovação (PINTEC)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) in partnership with MCTI / FINEP
reports.description: Triennial (historically) survey of innovation activities in Brazilian enterprises (industry, electricity/gas and selected services) with 10 or more persons employed. Measures product and process innovation, R&D, digital and green innovation, AI and related indicators. Relaunched in 2026 for the 2023–2025 reference period after a multi-year gap. Principal structural source on business innovation.

reports.title: Anuário Estatístico de Turismo
reports.publisher: Ministério do Turismo
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of tourism in Brazil, covering international (receptive) and domestic tourism, socio-economic indicators of the sector and selected international comparisons. Continues a long historical series previously maintained by Embratur. Complements IBGE household tourism modules (PNAD Contínua Turismo).

reports.title: PNAD Contínua – Turismo
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) in partnership with Ministério do Turismo
reports.description: Tourism module of the continuous PNAD Contínua providing household-based statistics on domestic travel (purpose, expenditure, destination characteristics). Published in partnership with the Ministry of Tourism. Complements the Anuário Estatístico de Turismo with demand-side household data.

reports.title: Pesquisa Industrial Mensal de Emprego e Salário (PIMES)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Monthly industrial employment and wage survey complementary to PIM-PF. Tracks employment, hours and earnings in industry. High-frequency labour input for industrial analysis and for the labour components of national accounts industrial estimates.

reports.title: Pesquisa Mensal de Comércio (PMC)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: Monthly retail trade survey measuring volume and nominal revenue of retail commerce. Key high-frequency indicator of household consumption demand and complementary to the structural PAC. Used in short-term economic analysis and as an input into quarterly national accounts.

reports.title: Brazil / IBGE Contribution to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: IBGE’s role as compiler, publisher and data contributor for successive editions of the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication (including the 2025 edition produced under Brazil’s pro-tempore presidency). Supplies national series on population, national accounts, prices, labour, living standards, industry, energy, agriculture, external sector and related domains that feed the comparable tables of the JSP and its Snapshot. Not a separate statistical survey; it is the institutional contribution channel linking the Brazilian statistical system to the BRICS NSO work programme.

dependencies.basis: The Censo Demográfico and all IBGE statistical operations cite Lei 5.534/1968 as the legal foundation for the obligation to respond and for the absolute confidentiality of individual information used exclusively for statistical purposes.

PNAD Contínua and other household surveys operate under the mandatory-response and statistical-secrecy provisions of Lei 5.534/1968, which is the standing legal basis for information collection by IBGE.

Lei 5.878/1973 defines IBGE’s mandate to produce the statistical information necessary for knowledge of the economic reality of the country and institutes the Plano Geral de Informações Estatísticas e Geográficas under which the Sistema de Contas Nacionais is produced.
Contas Regionais do Brasil and the municipal GDP series are compiled consistently with the national Sistema de Contas Nacionais and follow the same SNA 2008 framework and methodological principles.
Monthly industrial production indices from PIM-PF are a primary high-frequency input used in the estimation of quarterly and annual industrial value added within the Sistema de Contas Nacionais.
Labour-force, employment and earnings data from PNAD Contínua feed into compensation-of-employees estimates and related household-sector accounts in the national accounts framework.

PNAD Contínua sample design is based on a master sample of census tracts derived from the most recent Censo Demográfico; population estimates used for expansion factors are also anchored to census results.
Structural data from the Censo Agropecuário on agricultural production, land use, livestock and employment constitute a core benchmark input for the agricultural sector of the national accounts.

Balance-of-payments current and capital/financial account data compiled by the Banco Central are the primary source for the external transactions recorded in the Sistema de Contas Nacionais (rest-of-the-world account).

Consumer price indices (IPCA and related series) are used as deflators for household final consumption expenditure and other current-price aggregates when compiling volume measures in the national accounts.
For the multi-harvest crops investigated by LSPA, the final municipal estimates migrate automatically into the annual PAM at year-end, constituting a consolidation of the monthly survey results.

Municipal and higher-level agricultural production quantities and values from PAM are core structural inputs for estimating agricultural output and intermediate consumption in the Sistema de Contas Nacionais.
PIA-Empresa supplies structural benchmarks for industrial value added, employment, compensation and capital formation used in the compilation of the industrial sector of the national accounts.
Product-level quantity and value data from PIA-Produto feed the supply side of the supply-and-use tables and help determine the product composition of industrial output in the national accounts.
PAS is the principal structural source for non-financial services value added, employment and related aggregates incorporated into the services accounts of the Sistema de Contas Nacionais.
PAC supplies trade margins, employment and revenue data used to estimate the contribution of wholesale and retail trade in the national accounts distribution and value-added calculations.
PAIC provides the structural benchmarks for construction output, intermediate consumption and employment that underpin the construction industry estimates in the Sistema de Contas Nacionais.

The expenditure structures and basket weights of the IPCA (and INPC) are periodically updated using the results of the Pesquisa de Orçamentos Familiares; the most recent full reweighting incorporated POF 2008-2009 / later cycles.
Household final consumption expenditure estimates in the national accounts draw on the detailed consumption patterns and structures revealed by successive POF cycles.

Energy production, transformation and consumption data from the Balanço Energético Nacional are used as inputs for the energy-related components of intermediate consumption and for satellite energy accounts linked to the national accounts framework.

The Contas Econômicas Ambientais are constructed as an extension of the Sistema de Contas Nacionais under the SEEA framework, ensuring conceptual and classification consistency with the core economic accounts while adding physical and monetary environmental dimensions.

Vital statistics from the Registro Civil are used in inter-censal population estimates and demographic analysis that complement and help validate the decennial census results; the two systems together form the core of Brazil’s demographic statistical system.
The Contas Regionais for Federation Units are compiled under a uniform methodology that is fully consistent with, and constrained by, the national Sistema de Contas Nacionais (SNA 2008 framework).
Municipal GDP estimates are produced within the same Contas Regionais programme and share the same conceptual framework, classifications and balancing procedures as the state-level accounts.
SEADE produces the São Paulo state PIB series in methodological partnership with IBGE under the national Contas Regionais programme; state results are reconciled to the national totals.
Fundação João Pinheiro calculates Minas Gerais PIB as part of the IBGE Contas Regionais partnership; the state series is consistent with and contributes to the national regional accounts.
The DEE/SPGG of Rio Grande do Sul calculates state and municipal PIB in explicit methodological partnership with IBGE Contas Regionais.
SEI Bahia produces the state PIB series that feeds into and is consistent with the IBGE Contas Regionais for Bahia.

Amazonas state PIB estimates published by SEDECTI are aligned with the IBGE Contas Regionais framework and the national regional accounts programme (including SUFRAMA partnership for the Manaus Free Trade Zone).
Many SEADE labour, social and economic performance indicators are analysed and contextualised with reference to the state PIB series and its sectoral components.
The detailed Contas Regionais de Minas Gerais publication expands and documents the high-frequency PIB estimates produced by the same institution under the same methodological framework.
Municipal GDP figures for São Paulo municipalities form the geographic building blocks that aggregate into the state-level PIB estimates published by SEADE.
State-level SEADE PIB aggregates and analyses the municipal GDP building blocks (including the City of São Paulo) produced under the IBGE Contas Regionais programme.
DEE Rio Grande do Sul calculates state and municipal PIB in partnership with IBGE; the Porto Alegre municipal figure is a core input to the state series.
Manaus dominates Amazonas state GDP; the municipal estimate under IBGE Contas Regionais is the principal building block for the SEDECTI state PIB series.
ObservaSampa population and demographic indicators draw directly on IBGE Censo Demográfico results (including the 2022 Census) as the foundational population base for municipal indicators.

DATA.Rio / Instituto Pereira Passos publishes Censo 2022 aggregates by bairro, Região Administrativa and Área de Planejamento, performing municipal territorial attribution on top of the IBGE census frame.

Above-the-line fiscal flows from the Resultado do Tesouro Nacional feed the government sector accounts (revenue, expenditure, primary balance) within the Sistema de Contas Nacionais and related public-finance satellite presentations.
Monetary base, aggregates and monetary-authority survey data from the Banco Central are primary inputs to the financial accounts and monetary-sector components of the national accounts.
Changes in international reserves appear as the counterpart to the overall balance in the Balanço de Pagamentos; the stock series is the official measure of reserve assets.

The below-the-line fiscal result published by the BCB is analytically complementary to the above-the-line Resultado do Tesouro Nacional; both are used jointly to monitor the primary-result target and financing of the public sector.

The Pesquisa Nacional de Saúde evolved from earlier PNAD health supplements and shares household-survey methodological foundations with the continuous PNAD system, while operating as a dedicated health survey in partnership with the Ministry of Health.
Population denominators and age-structure data from the Censo Demográfico underpin enrolment rates and coverage indicators derived from the Censo Escolar.
BCB monetary and financial statistics are core source data for the compilation of the financial accounts within the Sistema de Contas Nacionais.
STN and BCB fiscal publications explicitly reference each other as complementary above-the-line and below-the-line measures of the same public-sector balance.
IPARDES calculates the Paraná PIB series in explicit methodological cooperation with the IBGE Contas Regionais programme; state results are reconciled to national totals.
SEPLAN-SC produces Santa Catarina PIB estimates and municipal analyses within the framework of the IBGE Contas Regionais partnership.
CONDEPE/FIDEM economic and population statistics for Pernambuco are aligned with IBGE Contas Regionais and demographic frameworks.

The two INEP censuses together form the complete structural statistical system for Brazilian education (basic + higher); they share institutional producer, classification principles and policy-use context even while remaining methodologically distinct operations.
The Paraná em Números interactive panel incorporates and contextualises the state and municipal PIB series produced by the same institution.
IPECE calculates the Ceará PIB series within the IBGE Contas Regionais partnership framework.
IPEDF is the official IBGE partner for Contas Regionais in the Distrito Federal and produces the DF PIB under that system (plus an independent quarterly series).
The Anuário Estatístico de Turismo draws on and is complementary to household tourism demand data from the PNAD Contínua Turismo module.
PIMES is the employment-and-wage counterpart to the physical-production focus of PIM-PF; both form the core high-frequency industrial monitoring suite of IBGE.
PMC provides the high-frequency retail volume and revenue indicators that complement the structural annual PAC enterprise survey.
PINTEC innovation indicators are analysed in the context of the industrial enterprise universe also covered by PIA-Empresa; the surveys share the enterprise statistical frame and CNAE classification.
Ceará em Números incorporates and contextualises the state PIB and related economic indicators produced by IPECE.
Brazilian national accounts (GDP levels, structure, growth) are supplied by IBGE to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication national-accounts tables.
IPCA and related Brazilian price indices feed the price-indices chapter of the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Labour-force, employment and living-standards indicators from PNAD Contínua are contributed to the corresponding chapters of the JSP.
Population totals, density and demographic structure from the Brazilian census system feed the population chapter of the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Agricultural production statistics (PAM and related livestock series) are supplied to the agriculture, forestry, livestock and fishery chapter of the JSP.
Brazilian energy balance data (BEN) contribute to the energy chapter of the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Balance-of-payments and external-sector aggregates from the Banco Central feed the foreign-economic-relations tables of the JSP.

IBGE, as the Brazilian National Statistical Office and 2025 compiling institution, supplies and coordinates the Brazilian national data package that constitutes Brazil’s contribution to each edition of the Joint Statistical Publication.
The same IBGE-compiled Brazilian data package feeds the shorter Snapshot edition of the Joint Statistical Publication.

IBGE participates in the meetings of Heads of BRICS National Statistical Offices that set the work programme and endorse the Joint Statistical Publication; the contribution channel is the operational counterpart of those coordination statements.
